testnet.enforcement: Required before value-bearing tests if supported by selected Hyperlane hook/router wrapper.

mainnet.enforcement: Required before mainnet beta. Do not rely on documentation-only caps.

notes: Native Hyperlane collateral/synthetic routers do not by themselves guarantee all Sentrix beta cap semantics.
If current Hyperlane contracts cannot enforce perTxCap, dailyCap, and totalMintCap directly, deploy a reviewed hook or wrapper that cannot withdraw user funds and cannot mint/release arbitrarily.
Frontend limits are advisory only and do not count as cap enforcement.
